

/* ===== 🏠 New home page (Option G premium) — 25-Oct-2026 =====
   Test: ?app=homeg. Switch on for everyone: Script Property HOME_V = new. Roll back: delete HOME_V (old Index is untouched) · anyone can open ?home=old.
   Certificates / notices / stars live in Script Properties HOME_CERTS / HOME_NOTICES / HOME_STARS (no new sheet); sample shown until a Sir saves. */
const HOMEG_DEF = {
  certs: [{ name: 'ISO 9001:2015', line: 'Quality management', icon: '✔', color: '#2563eb' }, { name: 'FSSAI', line: 'Food-grade packaging', icon: '🍃', color: '#16a34a' }, { name: 'BIS / ISI', line: 'Product standard', icon: '★', color: '#d0343c' }],
  notices: [{ icon: '🎉', text: 'Portal goes live on 26 Oct — use the app for every entry', by: 'Bhupinder Sir' }, { icon: '🛠', text: 'Machine PM every Sunday 8 AM', by: 'Maintenance' }],
  stars: [['Best operator', 'Name · machine · %'], ['Tasks on time', 'Name · 100%'], ['Best salesperson', 'Name · orders']]
};
function homeGBrands_(sir) {
  const ck = 'HOMEG_BR_' + (sir ? 1 : 0), C = CacheService.getScriptCache();
  try { const v = C.get(ck); if (v) return JSON.parse(v); } catch (e) {}
  const by = {};
  skuList_().filter(s => s.active && String(s.brand || '').trim()).forEach(s => {
    const b = String(s.brand).trim(); (by[b] = by[b] || []).push({ code: s.code, name: s.name, spec: s.spec, ml: s.ml, ppc: s.ppc, unit: s.unit, cat: s.category || s.product, rate: sir ? (s.rate || '') : '' });
  });
  const out = Object.keys(by).map(b => { const L = by[b], cnt = {}; L.forEach(i => { if (i.cat) cnt[i.cat] = (cnt[i.cat] || 0) + 1; });
    const top = Object.keys(cnt).sort((x, y) => cnt[y] - cnt[x])[0] || '';
    return { brand: b, n: L.length, desc: top, rates: sir ? 1 : 0, items: L.slice(0, 400) }; }).sort((a, b) => b.n - a.n);
  try { const j = JSON.stringify(out); if (j.length < 95000) C.put(ck, j, 600); } catch (e) {}
  return out;
}
function homeGData(token) {
  const u = poUser_(token); if (!u) throw new Error('Please sign in again');
  const sir = pcSir_(u), P = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
  const J = k => { try { const v = P.getProperty(k); return v ? JSON.parse(v) : null; } catch (e) { return null; } };
  const c = J('HOME_CERTS'), n = J('HOME_NOTICES'), s = J('HOME_STARS'), out = { base: portalUrl_() };
  out.certs = c || HOMEG_DEF.certs; out.certSample = c ? 0 : 1;
  out.notices = n || HOMEG_DEF.notices; out.noticeSample = n ? 0 : 1;
  out.stars = s || HOMEG_DEF.stars; out.starSample = s ? 0 : 1;
  try { out.brands = homeGBrands_(sir); } catch (e) { out.brands = []; out.brandErr = String(e.message || e); }
  return out;
}
function homeGSave(token, kind, list) {
  const u = poUser_(token); if (!u || !pcSir_(u)) throw new Error('Only Bhupinder Sir / Rishu Sir can change this');
  const key = { certs: 'HOME_CERTS', notices: 'HOME_NOTICES', stars: 'HOME_STARS' }[kind]; if (!key) throw new Error('Unknown list');
  const t = v => String(v == null ? '' : v).slice(0, 300);
  const L = (Array.isArray(list) ? list : []).slice(0, 20).map(o => Array.isArray(o) ? [t(o[0]), t(o[1])] : Object.keys(o || {}).reduce((m, k) => { if (/^(name|line|link|expiry|icon|color|text|by)$/.test(k)) m[k] = t(o[k]); return m; }, {}));
  PropertiesService.getScriptProperties().setProperty(key, JSON.stringify(L));
  return homeGData(token);
}

 .bar a{text-align:center;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--mut)}.bar a i{display:block;font-style:normal;font-size:19px;margin-bottom:2px}.bar a.on{color:var(--navy)}.bar .mid i{width:44px;height:44px;margin:-20px auto 2px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#7c3aed,#2563eb);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 8px 18px -6px #4f46e5}

<body>
<header class="top">
  <img class="lg" id="logo" alt="">
  <div><div class="bn">SUNPACK INDUSTRIES</div><div class="bs">Packaging Freshness</div></div>
  <nav class="nav"><a href="#" class="on" id="nHome">⌂ Home</a><a href="#apps" id="nApps">▦ All Apps</a><a href="#" id="nRep">📑 Reports</a></nav>
  <label class="sr">🔍<input id="q" placeholder="Search apps…" autocomplete="off"></label>
  <span class="spacer sp"></span>
  <button class="ib" id="btnEye" title="Show amounts" style="display:none">👁</button>
  <button class="ib hide-m" id="btnRef" title="Refresh">↻</button>
  <a class="ib hide-m" id="btnOld" title="Old home page · password">🔑</a>
  <div class="usr"><div class="av" id="av">S</div><div><b id="uname">…</b><small id="urole"></small></div></div>
  <button class="ib hide-m" id="btnOut" title="Sign out">⎋</button>
</header>
<div class="lay">
  <aside class="side" id="side"></aside>
  <main class="mainc" id="main"><div class="empty" style="padding:40px;text-align:center">Loading…</div></main>
  <aside class="rt" id="right"></aside>
</div>
<nav class="bar" id="bar"></nav>
<div class="mod" id="mod"><div class="mbox" id="mbox"></div></div>
<div id="toast"></div><div id="printArea"></div>
<script>
var HAS_GAS = !!(window.google && google.script && google.script.run);
function call(fn){ var a=[].slice.call(arguments,1); return new Promise(function(res,rej){ if(!HAS_GAS) return setTimeout(function(){ try{ res(DEMO[fn].apply(null,a)); }catch(e){ rej(e); } },120); var r=google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(res).withFailureHandler(rej); r[fn].apply(r,a); }); }
var store={ get:function(k){ try{ return localStorage.getItem(k); }catch(e){ return null; } }, set:function(k,v){ try{ v==null?localStorage.removeItem(k):localStorage.setItem(k,v); }catch(e){} } };
function $(id){ return document.getElementById(id); }
function esc(s){ return String(s==null?'':s).replace(/[&<>"']/g,function(c){ return {'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]; }); }
function toast(m){ var t=$('toast'); t.textContent=m; t.style.display='block'; clearTimeout(t._h); t._h=setTimeout(function(){ t.style.display='none'; },3000); }
var LOGO='data:image/png;base64,';
var S={ token: store.get('bp_token'), data:null, x:null, more:null, task:'', grp:'all', q:'', fac: store.get('hg_fac')||'' };
/* ---------- icons (simple line icons) ---------- */
var I={cart:'<circle cx="8" cy="21" r="1"/><circle cx="19" cy="21" r="1"/><path d="M2 3h3l2.7 12.4a2 2 0 0 0 2 1.6h8.6a2 2 0 0 0 2-1.6L22 7H6"/>',truck:'<path d="M14 17V5H2v12h2"/><path d="M14 9h4l4 4v4h-2"/><circle cx="7" cy="17" r="2"/><circle cx="17" cy="17" r="2"/><path d="M9 17h6"/>',users:'<circle cx="9" cy="8" r="4"/><path d="M2 21a7 7 0 0 1 14 0"/><path d="M16 4a4 4 0 0 1 0 8M22 21a7 7 0 0 0-4-6.3"/>',sprout:'<path d="M12 21V11"/><path d="M12 11C12 7 9 4 4 4c0 5 3 7 8 7Z"/><path d="M12 13c0-4 3-6 8-6 0 4-3 6-8 6Z"/>',factory:'<path d="M2 21V10l6 4V10l6 4V6l8 4v11Z"/><path d="M6 17h2M12 17h2"/>',gear:'<circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/><path d="M12 2v3M12 19v3M2 12h3M19 12h3M4.9 4.9 7 7M17 17l2.1 2.1M4.9 19.1 7 17M17 7l2.1-2.1"/>',check:'<path d="M12 2 4 6v6c0 5 3.5 8.5 8 10 4.5-1.5 8-5 8-10V6Z"/><path d="m8.5 12 2.5 2.5 4.5-5"/>',box:'<path d="M21 8 12 3 3 8v8l9 5 9-5Z"/><path d="M3 8l9 5 9-5M12 13v8"/>',clip:'<rect x="6" y="4" width="12" height="17" rx="2"/><path d="M9 4V3h6v1M9 11h6M9 15h4"/>',receipt:'<path d="M5 2h14v20l-3-2-2 2-2-2-2 2-2-2-3 2Z"/><path d="M9 7h6M9 11h6M9 15h3"/>',tasks:'<path d="m3 6 2 2 4-4M3 14l2 2 4-4"/><path d="M13 6h8M13 14h8M13 20h8"/>',compass:'<circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><path d="m16 8-2.5 5.5L8 16l2.5-5.5Z"/>',star:'<path d="m12 2 3 6.5 7 .8-5.2 4.8 1.4 7L12 17.6 5.8 21l1.4-7L2 9.3l7-.8Z"/>',bag:'<path d="M6 7h12l1 14H5Z"/><path d="M9 7a3 3 0 0 1 6 0"/>',calc:'<rect x="5" y="2" width="14" height="20" rx="2"/><path d="M8 6h8M8 11h2M12 11h2M8 15h2M12 15h2M8 19h2M12 19h2M16 15v4"/>',cal:'<rect x="3" y="5" width="18" height="16" rx="2"/><path d="M3 10h18M8 3v4M16 3v4M9 15l2 2 4-4"/>',gate:'<path d="M3 21V7l9-4 9 4v14"/><path d="M7 21v-8h10v8M7 17h10"/>',boxes:'<path d="M7 3h10v7H7zM3 12h8v9H3zM13 12h8v9h-8z"/>',sheet:'<rect x="4" y="3" width="16" height="18" rx="2"/><path d="M4 9h16M4 15h16M10 3v18"/>',app:'<rect x="3" y="3" width="7" height="7" rx="1.5"/><rect x="14" y="3" width="7" height="7" rx="1.5"/><rect x="3" y="14" width="7" height="7" rx="1.5"/><rect x="14" y="14" width="7" height="7" rx="1.5"/>',cup:'<path d="M5 4h14l-2 17H7Z"/><path d="M5.6 9h12.8"/>'};
function ic(k,s,c,w){ return '<svg width="'+(s||22)+'" height="'+(s||22)+'" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="'+(c||'currentColor')+'" stroke-width="'+(w||2)+'" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">'+(I[k]||I.app)+'</svg>'; }
/* app → icon / colour / group from its link (falls back to the Apps sheet values) */
var APPMAP=[[/app=admin/,'star','#1e293b','Management'],[/app=coord/,'compass','#334760','Management'],[/app=dlg/,'tasks','#7c3aed','Management'],[/app=so\b/,'truck','#0d9488','Sales'],[/app=crm/,'users','#db2777','Sales'],[/app=nbd/,'sprout','#c2410c','Sales'],[/app=desk/,'factory','#b45309','Factory & Production'],[/app=pms/,'gear','#ea580c','Factory & Production'],[/app=ims/,'boxes','#16a34a','Factory & Production'],[/app=qc/,'check','#15803d','Factory & Production'],[/app=pcheck/,'clip','#475569','Factory & Production'],[/app=po\b/,'bag','#4f46e5','Purchase & Accounts'],[/app=acs/,'calc','#3f6b7a','Purchase & Accounts']];
var CATG={management:'Management',sales:'Sales',production:'Factory & Production',factory:'Factory & Production',inventory:'Factory & Production',purchase:'Purchase & Accounts',accounts:'Purchase & Accounts',hr:'HR & Security',security:'HR & Security'};
var GROUPS=[['Management','#1e293b','star','⭐'],['Sales','#0d9488','truck','🚚'],['Factory & Production','#b45309','factory','🏭'],['Purchase & Accounts','#4f46e5','bag','🛒'],['HR & Security','#be185d','cal','👥'],['Other','#475569','app','▦']];
function meta(a){ var u=(a.url||a.sheetUrl||'')+' '+(a.name||''); for(var i=0;i<APPMAP.length;i++) if(APPMAP[i][0].test(u)) return {icon:APPMAP[i][1],color:APPMAP[i][2],grp:APPMAP[i][3]};
  var n=String(a.name||'').toLowerCase(), g=CATG[String(a.category||'').toLowerCase()]||'Other';
  return { icon: /attend/.test(n)?'cal':/gate/.test(n)?'gate':'app', color: a.color||'#475569', grp: g }; }
function sir(){ var u=S.data&&S.data.user; return !!u && u.role==='Admin' && !u.readonly && u.rtype!=='pc'; }
function isPc(){ var u=S.data&&S.data.user; return !!u && u.rtype==='pc'; }
/* ---------- load ---------- */
async function boot(){
  if(!S.token && HAS_GAS){ return toOld(); }
  var k='hg_cache_'+(S.token||'demo'), c=null; try{ c=JSON.parse(store.get(k)||'null'); }catch(e){}
  if(c && c.d && Date.now()-c.t<3*864e5){ S.data=c.d; S.x=c.x||null; paint(); }       /* last numbers at once, fresh ones follow */
  try{ var d=await call('getPortalData',S.token); if(!d||!d.user){ return toOld(); }
    var u=d.user, desk=u.rtype==='prodhead' && (d.apps||[]).find(function(a){ return /app=desk/.test(a.url||''); }); if(desk){ window.open(desk.url,'_top'); return; }
    S.data=d; paint(); store.set(k,JSON.stringify({t:Date.now(),d:d,x:S.x}));
  }catch(e){ if(!S.data) $('main').innerHTML='<div class="card mt"><b>Could not load:</b> '+esc(e.message||e)+' <a class="edit" href="#" onclick="toOld();return false">Open the old home page</a></div>'; return; }
  call('homeGData',S.token).then(function(x){ S.x=x; paint(); try{ var cc=JSON.parse(store.get(k)||'{}'); cc.x=x; store.set(k,JSON.stringify(cc)); }catch(e){} }).catch(function(){});
  call('homeMoreTasks',S.token).then(function(x){ S.more=Array.isArray(x)?x:[]; paint(); }).catch(function(){});
}
function base(){ if(S.x&&S.x.base) return S.x.base; var a=((S.data&&S.data.apps)||[]).find(function(a){ return /\/exec\?/.test(a.url||''); }); return a?a.url.split('?')[0]:''; }
function toOld(){ var b=base()||''; window.open((b||'?')+(b?'?':'')+'home=old','_top'); }
function tasks(){ var T=((S.data&&S.data.tasks)||[]).slice(), x=S.more||[]; T=T.filter(function(t){ return !x.some(function(n){ return n.app===t.app; }); }); if(x.some(function(n){return n.app==='Decisions';})) T=T.filter(function(t){ return t.app!=='Approvals'; });
  var TOP=['Decisions','Production plan 5 PM','Stock check gaps']; return x.filter(function(n){ return TOP.indexOf(n.app)>-1; }).concat(T, x.filter(function(n){ return TOP.indexOf(n.app)<0; })); }
function tmeta(t){ var n=(t.app||'')+' '+(t.url||''); var m=[[/Decision/,'check','#0f1d33'],[/plan/i,'cal','#b45309'],[/Stock check/,'clip','#7c3aed'],[/Purchase|app=po/,'bag','#4f46e5'],[/Sale|O2D|app=so/,'truck','#0d9488'],[/Deleg/,'tasks','#9333ea'],[/PMS/,'factory','#0284c7'],[/Rate/,'receipt','#dc2626'],[/CRM/,'users','#db2777'],[/NBD/,'sprout','#c2410c'],[/Account|ACS/,'calc','#0f766e'],[/PC/,'compass','#334760'],[/Low stock/,'boxes','#dc2626']];
  for(var i=0;i<m.length;i++) if(m[i][0].test(n)) return {icon:m[i][1],color:m[i][2]}; return {icon:'tasks',color:t.color||'#4f46e5'}; }
/* ---------- paint ---------- */
function paint(){ if(!S.data) return; var d=S.data, u=d.user||{}, x=S.x||{};
  var lg=LOGO; $('logo').src=lg;
  $('uname').textContent=u.name||''; $('urole').textContent=(u.title||u.role||'')+(isPc()?' · view sheets':''); $('av').textContent=String(u.name||'S').charAt(0).toUpperCase();
  document.title='Sunpack Industries — Home';
  var eb=$('btnEye'); eb.style.display=sir()?'':'none'; var on=store.get('bp_eye')==='1'; eb.classList.toggle('on',on);
  $('nRep').href = sir()? base()+'?app=admin' : isPc()? base()+'?app=coord&tab=mis' : '#';
  var apps=(d.apps||[]).filter(function(a){ return !a.hidden; });
  apps.forEach(function(a){ var m=meta(a); a._i=m.icon; a._c=m.color; a._g=m.grp; });
  S.apps=apps;
  $('side').innerHTML = sideHtml(apps);
  $('main').innerHTML = mainHtml(apps);
  $('right').innerHTML = rightHtml();
  $('bar').innerHTML = barHtml();
  wire();
}
function grpCount(apps,g){ return apps.filter(function(a){ return a._g===g; }).length; }
function sideHtml(apps){ var h='<h4>DEPARTMENTS</h4><div class="it '+(S.grp==='all'?'on':'')+'" data-g="all"><i>▦</i>All apps<span>'+apps.length+'</span></div>';
  GROUPS.forEach(function(g){ var n=grpCount(apps,g[0]); if(n) h+='<div class="it '+(S.grp===g[0]?'on':'')+'" data-g="'+esc(g[0])+'"><i>'+g[3]+'</i>'+esc(g[0])+'<span>'+n+'</span></div>'; });
  var sh=apps.filter(function(a){ return a.sheetUrl; });
  if(sh.length){ h+='<h4>GOOGLE SHEETS'+(sir()?'':' · VIEW')+'</h4>'+sh.map(function(a){ return '<a class="sh" target="_blank" href="'+esc(a.sheetUrl)+'">'+ic('sheet',16,'#16a34a')+' '+esc(shortName(a.name))+'<small>'+esc(a._g.split(' ')[0])+'</small></a>'; }).join(''); }
  h+=brandHtml()+certHtml(); return h; }
function shortName(n){ return String(n||'').replace(/\s*[–-]\s.*$/,'').replace(/ & Collection/,''); }
function brandHtml(){ return '<div class="brand"><img src="'+esc(LOGO)+'" alt=""><b>SUNPACK INDUSTRIES</b><i>Packaging Freshness</i><span>PP Factory Sewah · PET Kurar</span></div>'; }
function certHtml(){ var x=S.x||{}, C=x.certs||[]; var h='<div class="certc"><div class="ct"><span>🏅 Our certificates'+(x.certSample?'<span class="sample">sample</span>':'')+'</span>'+(sir()?'<button class="edit" data-ed="certs">✎ Edit</button>':'')+'</div>';
  if(!C.length) return h+'<div class="empty">'+(x.certs?'No certificates yet':'Loading…')+'</div></div>';
  var soon=null; h+=C.map(function(c){ var dl=c.expiry?Math.ceil((new Date(c.expiry)-new Date())/864e5):null; if(dl!=null&&dl<=45&&(!soon||dl<soon.d)) soon={n:c.name,d:dl};
    return '<a class="cr" style="--c:'+esc(c.color||'#2563eb')+'" '+(c.link?'target="_blank" href="'+esc(c.link)+'"':'')+'><span class="seal">'+esc(c.icon||'✔')+'</span><div><b>'+esc(c.name)+'</b><small>'+esc(c.line||'')+'</small></div>'+(c.link?'<span class="pdf">PDF</span>':'')+'</a>'; }).join('');
  if(soon) h+='<div class="exp">⏰ '+esc(soon.n)+(soon.d<0?' expired '+(-soon.d)+' days ago':' renews in '+soon.d+' days')+'</div>';
  return h+'</div>'; }
function hello(){ var h=new Date().getHours(); return h<12?'Good morning':h<17?'Good afternoon':'Good evening'; }
function mainHtml(apps){ var u=S.data.user||{}, T=tasks(), tot=0, late=0; T.forEach(function(t){ tot+=t.total||0; late+=t.overdue||0; });
  var d=new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-IN',{weekday:'long',day:'numeric',month:'long',year:'numeric'});
  var h='<div class="hello"><div><h1>'+hello()+', '+esc(u.name||'')+' 👋</h1><p>'+esc(u.title||u.role||'')+' · '+esc(d)+'</p></div><div class="fac">'+[['','Both factories'],['PP','PP Factory Sewah'],['PET','PET Kurar']].map(function(f){ return '<button data-fac="'+f[0]+'" class="'+(S.fac===f[0]?'on':'')+'">'+f[1]+'</button>'; }).join('')+'</div></div>';
  if(T.length){ h+='<div class="card mt"><h2>My tasks <small>'+tot+' pending'+(late?' · <em>'+late+' late</em>':'')+' · tap a box to see the list</small></h2><div class="tks">'+T.map(function(t){ var m=tmeta(t); return '<button class="tk '+(S.task===t.app?'sel':'')+'" data-t="'+esc(t.app)+'" style="--c:'+m.color+'"><div class="i">'+ic(m.icon,17,'#fff')+'</div><div><b>'+esc(t.short||t.app)+'</b><span class="'+(t.overdue?'r':'')+'">'+(t.error?'could not load':t.overdue?t.overdue+' late':'None late')+'</span></div><div class="n '+(t.overdue?'r':'')+'">'+(t.total||0)+'</div></button>'; }).join('')+'</div>'+taskDet(T)+'</div>'; }
  h+='<div class="chips">'+'<button data-g="all" class="'+(S.grp==='all'?'on':'')+'">All '+apps.length+'</button>'+GROUPS.filter(function(g){ return grpCount(apps,g[0]); }).map(function(g){ return '<button data-g="'+esc(g[0])+'" class="'+(S.grp===g[0]?'on':'')+'">'+g[3]+' '+esc(g[0].split(' ')[0])+'</button>'; }).join('')+'</div>';
  h+=prodHtml();
  var q=S.q.toLowerCase(), A=apps.filter(function(a){ return (S.grp==='all'||a._g===S.grp) && (!q || (a.name+' '+a.desc+' '+a.category).toLowerCase().indexOf(q)>-1); });
  h+='<div id="apps"></div>';
  GROUPS.forEach(function(g){ var L=A.filter(function(a){ return a._g===g[0]; }); if(!L.length) return;
    h+='<div class="sec" style="--c:'+g[1]+'"><i>'+ic(g[2],15,'#fff')+'</i>'+esc(g[0].toUpperCase())+' <small>'+L.length+' apps</small></div><div class="grid">'+L.map(cardHtml).join('')+'</div>'; });
  if(!A.length) h+='<div class="empty">No app matches “'+esc(S.q)+'”.</div>';
  if(window.innerWidth<=820) h+='<div class="sideM">'+sideHtml(apps).replace(/<h4>DEPARTMENTS[\s\S]*?(?=<h4>GOOGLE|<div class="brand")/,'')+'</div>';
  return h; }
function taskDet(T){ var t=T.find(function(x){ return x.app===S.task; }); if(!t) return '';
  if(t.error) return '<div class="det"><span style="color:var(--red)">Could not load '+esc(t.app)+': '+esc(t.error)+'</span></div>';
  var L=(t.list||[]).slice(0,30); return '<div class="det"><b>'+esc(t.app)+'</b>'+(L.length?L.map(function(r){ return '<div class="row"><div><b>'+esc(r.step||'')+'</b><small>'+esc([r.item,r.indent,r.location].filter(Boolean).join(' · '))+'</small></div><span class="due '+(r.overdue?'r':'')+'">'+esc(r.planned||'')+'</span></div>'; }).join(''):'<div class="empty">Nothing pending.</div>')+(t.url?'<a class="go" href="'+esc(t.url)+'">Open '+esc(t.short||t.app)+' →</a>':'')+'</div>'; }
function liveOf(a){ var T=tasks(), m=a.url||''; var t=T.find(function(t){ return t.url && m && t.url.split('?')[1] && m.indexOf(t.url.split('?')[1].split('&')[0])>-1; }); return t&&t.total? t.total+(t.overdue?' · '+t.overdue+' late':' pending'):''; }
function tagsOf(a){ var c=a.category||'', ac=a.access||''; return '<span>'+esc(c)+'</span>'+(ac?'<span class="'+(/admin/i.test(ac)&&!/staff/i.test(ac)?'x':'a')+'">'+esc(ac)+'</span>':''); }
function cardHtml(a){ var lv=liveOf(a); return '<div class="card ap" style="--c:'+a._c+'"><div class="wm">'+ic(a._i,120,'currentColor',1.5)+'</div><div class="h"><div class="ic">'+ic(a._i,23,'#fff')+'</div><div><b>'+esc(a.name)+'</b><div class="tg">'+tagsOf(a)+'</div></div></div><p>'+esc(a.desc||'')+'</p>'+(lv?'<span class="live">'+esc(lv)+'</span>':'')+
  '<div class="btns">'+(a.soon?'<div class="soon">⏳ Coming soon</div>':a.locked?'<div class="soon">🔒 No access</div>':'<a class="bo" data-open="'+esc(a.name)+'" href="'+esc(a.url)+'">Open app →</a>')+(a.sheetUrl?'<a class="bsh" target="_blank" href="'+esc(a.sheetUrl)+'">'+ic('sheet',14)+' Sheet</a>':'')+'</div></div>'; }
var BCOL={Sunpack:'#d0343c',Symphony:'#2563eb','Olive Bio':'#16a34a',Sunfresh:'#f59e0b','Wooden Spoon':'#92400e'};
function bcol(b){ return BCOL[b]||['#0d9488','#7c3aed','#db2777','#0284c7'][String(b).length%4]; }
function cupSvg(c,s){ return '<svg viewBox="0 0 80 80" width="'+(s||70)+'" height="'+(s||70)+'"><path d="M18 18h44l-6 50a4 4 0 0 1-4 4H28a4 4 0 0 1-4-4z" fill="#fff" stroke="'+c+'" stroke-width="3"/><path d="M21 30h38" stroke="'+c+'" stroke-width="3"/><path d="M24 44h32" stroke="'+c+'" stroke-width="2" opacity=".4"/><ellipse cx="40" cy="18" rx="22" ry="4" fill="#fff" stroke="'+c+'" stroke-width="3"/></svg>'; }
function prodHtml(){ var B=(S.x&&S.x.brands)||null; if(!B) return '<div class="card prod"><div class="ph"><h3>🥤 Our products</h3><span>Loading…</span></div></div>'; if(!B.length) return '';
  var n=B.reduce(function(s,b){ return s+b.n; },0);
  return '<div class="card prod"><div class="ph"><h3>🥤 Our products</h3><span>'+B.length+' brands · '+n+' items · tap a brand for its portfolio to send to a party</span></div><div class="pg">'+B.map(function(b){ var c=bcol(b.brand); return '<div class="pc" data-brand="'+esc(b.brand)+'" style="--c:'+c+'"><div class="pi">'+(b.photo?'<img src="'+esc(b.photo)+'" alt="">':cupSvg(c))+'</div><b>'+esc(b.brand)+'</b><small>'+esc(b.desc||(b.n+' items'))+'</small></div>'; }).join('')+'</div></div>'; }
function rightHtml(){ var x=S.x||{}, h='';
  var K=x.today||autoToday(); h+='<div class="card"><h3>☀ Today at Sunpack</h3><div class="k">'+K.map(function(k){ return '<div class="'+(k[2]?'r':'')+'"><b>'+esc(k[0])+'</b><span>'+esc(k[1])+'</span></div>'; }).join('')+'</div></div>';
  if(sir()) h+='<div class="card ai"><h3>✨ Ask Sunpack AI</h3><p>Answers from the portal data · read-only</p><a href="'+esc(base()+'?app=admin')+'">kaunse orders late hain? →</a></div>';
  var Q=quick(); if(Q.length) h+='<div class="card"><h3>⚡ Quick actions</h3><div class="qa">'+Q.map(function(q){ return '<a href="'+esc(base()+q[2])+'"><i>'+q[0]+'</i>'+esc(q[1])+'</a>'; }).join('')+'</div></div>';
  var N=x.notices||[]; h+='<div class="card"><h3>📢 Notice board'+(x.noticeSample?'<span class="sample">sample</span>':'')+(sir()?'<button class="edit" data-ed="notices">✎ Edit</button>':'')+'</h3>'+(N.length?N.map(function(n){ return '<div class="nb"><span>'+esc(n.icon||'📌')+'</span><div><b>'+esc(n.text)+'</b><small>'+esc(n.by||'')+'</small></div></div>'; }).join(''):'<div class="empty">'+(x.notices?'No notices':'Loading…')+'</div>')+'</div>';
  var ST=x.stars||[]; if(ST.length||sir()) h+='<div class="card"><h3>🏆 Stars of the week'+(x.starSample?'<span class="sample">sample</span>':'')+(sir()?'<button class="edit" data-ed="stars">✎ Edit</button>':'')+'</h3>'+ST.map(function(s){ return '<div class="li"><span>'+esc(s[0])+'</span><b>'+esc(s[1])+'</b></div>'; }).join('')+'</div>';
  var R=recent(); if(R.length) h+='<div class="card"><h3>🕘 Recently opened</h3>'+R.map(function(r){ return '<a class="li" href="'+esc(r.u)+'"><span>'+esc(r.n)+'</span><small>'+ago(r.t)+'</small></a>'; }).join('')+'</div>';
  return h; }
function autoToday(){ var T=tasks(), tot=0, late=0; T.forEach(function(t){ tot+=t.total||0; late+=t.overdue||0; }); var big=T.slice().sort(function(a,b){ return (b.total||0)-(a.total||0); }).slice(0,4);
  return [[String(tot),'my tasks'],[String(late),'late',late>0]].concat(big.map(function(t){ return [String(t.total||0),t.short||t.app,t.overdue>0]; })); }
function quick(){ var A=S.apps||[], has=function(re){ return A.some(function(a){ return re.test(a.url||''); }); }, Q=[];
  if(has(/app=so\b/)) Q.push(['🧾','New sale order','?app=so&tab=new']); if(has(/app=po\b/)) Q.push(['📝','Raise requirement','?app=po&tab=raise']);
  if(has(/app=desk/)) { Q.push(['📥','GRN','?app=desk&tab=grn']); Q.push(['🚚','Dispatch','?app=desk&tab=disp']); Q.push(['✍','Shift entry','?app=desk&tab=prod']); }
  if(has(/app=crm/)) Q.push(['📞','CRM My Tasks','?app=crm&tab=today']); if(has(/app=coord/)) { Q.push(['✍','Enter for','?app=coord&tab=enter']); Q.push(['📊','Daily MIS','?app=coord&tab=mis']); }
  if(has(/app=ims/)) Q.push(['🔢','Physical count','?app=ims&tab=phys']); if(has(/app=acs/)) Q.push(['🧮','Tally check','?app=acs&tab=tally']); if(has(/app=nbd/)) Q.push(['➕','New lead','?app=nbd']);
  return Q.slice(0,6); }
function recent(){ try{ return JSON.parse(store.get('hg_recent')||'[]').slice(0,4); }catch(e){ return []; } }
function ago(t){ var m=Math.round((Date.now()-t)/6e4); return m<1?'just now':m<60?m+' min ago':m<1440?Math.round(m/60)+' h ago':Math.round(m/1440)+' d ago'; }
function barHtml(){ var R=sir()?base()+'?app=admin':isPc()?base()+'?app=coord&tab=mis':'#'; return '<a class="on" href="#"><i>⌂</i>Home</a><a href="#apps" data-jump="1"><i>▦</i>Apps</a>'+(sir()?'<a class="mid" href="'+esc(base()+'?app=admin')+'"><i>✨</i>Ask AI</a>':'<a class="mid" href="#" data-speak="1"><i>🎤</i>Speak</a>')+'<a href="'+esc(R)+'"><i>📑</i>Reports</a><a href="#" data-new="1"><i>⚡</i>New</a>'; }
/* ---------- events ---------- */
function wire(){
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-g]').forEach(function(b){ b.onclick=function(){ S.grp=b.dataset.g; paint(); var a=$('apps'); if(a) a.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'start'}); }; });
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-t]').forEach(function(b){ b.onclick=function(){ S.task=S.task===b.dataset.t?'':b.dataset.t; paint(); }; });
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-fac]').forEach(function(b){ b.onclick=function(){ S.fac=b.dataset.fac; store.set('hg_fac',S.fac); paint(); toast(S.fac?'Showing '+b.textContent:'Both factories'); }; });
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-open]').forEach(function(a){ a.addEventListener('click',function(){ try{ var R=recent().filter(function(r){ return r.n!==a.dataset.open; }); R.unshift({n:a.dataset.open,u:a.getAttribute('href'),t:Date.now()}); store.set('hg_recent',JSON.stringify(R.slice(0,6))); }catch(e){} }); });
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-brand]').forEach(function(b){ b.onclick=function(){ portfolio(b.dataset.brand); }; });
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-ed]').forEach(function(b){ b.onclick=function(e){ e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); editor(b.dataset.ed); }; });
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-jump]').forEach(function(b){ b.onclick=function(e){ e.preventDefault(); var a=$('apps'); if(a) a.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'}); }; });
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-speak]').forEach(function(b){ b.onclick=function(e){ e.preventDefault(); var v=$('vxBtn'); if(v) v.click(); }; });
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-new]').forEach(function(b){ b.onclick=function(e){ e.preventDefault(); var Q=quick(); openMod('<h2 style="margin-bottom:10px">⚡ New entry</h2><div class="qa">'+Q.map(function(q){ return '<a href="'+esc(base()+q[2])+'"><i>'+q[0]+'</i>'+esc(q[1])+'</a>'; }).join('')+'</div><div class="pfa"><button class="btn l" data-x="1">Close</button></div>'); }; });
}
$('q').oninput=function(){ S.q=this.value.trim(); paint(); };
$('nApps').onclick=function(e){ e.preventDefault(); var a=$('apps'); if(a) a.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'}); };
$('nHome').onclick=function(e){ e.preventDefault(); window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'}); };
$('btnRef').onclick=function(){ try{ localStorage.removeItem('hg_cache_'+S.token); }catch(e){} location.reload(); };
$('btnOld').onclick=function(e){ e.preventDefault(); toOld(); };
$('btnEye').onclick=function(){ var v=store.get('bp_eye')!=='1'; store.set('bp_eye',v?'1':'0'); this.classList.toggle('on',v); toast(v?'👁 Amounts will show in Admin Console, ACS and dashboards':'👁 Amounts hidden'); };
$('btnOut').onclick=async function(){ try{ await call('logout',S.token); }catch(e){} store.set('bp_token',null); toOld(); };
function openMod(h){ $('mbox').innerHTML=h; $('mod').classList.add('show'); $('mbox').querySelectorAll('[data-x]').forEach(function(b){ b.onclick=closeMod; }); }
function closeMod(){ $('mod').classList.remove('show'); }
$('mod').onclick=function(e){ if(e.target.id==='mod') closeMod(); };
/* ---------- 🥤 brand portfolio: pick items → WhatsApp / Print-PDF / Copy to send to a party ---------- */
function portfolio(brand){ var b=((S.x&&S.x.brands)||[]).find(function(x){ return x.brand===brand; }); if(!b) return; var c=bcol(brand), sel={}, rate=false, q='';
  function draw(){ var L=b.items.filter(function(i){ return !q || (i.name+' '+i.code+' '+i.spec).toLowerCase().indexOf(q)>-1; }), n=Object.keys(sel).length;
    openMod('<div class="pfh" style="--c:'+c+'"><img src="'+esc(LOGO)+'" alt=""><div><h2>'+esc(brand)+' — product portfolio</h2><small>'+b.items.length+' items · Sunpack Industries · Packaging Freshness</small></div></div>'+
      '<div class="pft"><input type="search" id="pfq" placeholder="Search in '+esc(brand)+'…" value="'+esc(q)+'"><button class="btn l" id="pfAll">'+(n===b.items.length?'Clear all':'Select all')+'</button>'+(b.rates?'<label style="font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600"><input type="checkbox" id="pfR" '+(rate?'checked':'')+'> with list rate</label>':'')+'</div>'+
      '<div class="pfg">'+L.map(function(i){ return '<div class="pfi '+(sel[i.code]?'on':'')+'" data-i="'+esc(i.code)+'" style="--c:'+c+'"><div class="ph2">'+(i.photo?'<img src="'+esc(i.photo)+'" alt="">':cupSvg(c,44))+'</div><div><b>'+esc(i.name)+'</b><small>'+esc([i.spec,i.ml?i.ml+' ml':'',i.ppc?i.ppc+' pcs/ctn':''].filter(Boolean).join(' · '))+'</small><small style="color:#94a3b8">'+esc(i.code)+(rate&&i.rate?' · ₹'+i.rate+'/'+esc(i.unit||''):'')+'</small></div></div>'; }).join('')+'</div>'+
      '<div class="pfa"><span style="margin-right:auto;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--mut)">'+(n?n+' selected':'Tap items to choose (or send all)')+'</span><button class="btn l" data-x="1">Close</button><button class="btn l" id="pfCopy">Copy</button><button class="btn n" id="pfPdf">🖨 Print / PDF</button><button class="btn g" id="pfWa">WhatsApp</button></div>');
    var pq=$('pfq'); pq.oninput=function(){ q=this.value.toLowerCase(); draw(); var z=$('pfq'); z.focus(); z.setSelectionRange(z.value.length,z.value.length); };
    $('pfAll').onclick=function(){ if(Object.keys(sel).length===b.items.length) sel={}; else b.items.forEach(function(i){ sel[i.code]=1; }); draw(); };
    if($('pfR')) $('pfR').onchange=function(){ rate=this.checked; draw(); };
    $('mbox').querySelectorAll('[data-i]').forEach(function(e){ e.onclick=function(){ var k=e.dataset.i; if(sel[k]) delete sel[k]; else sel[k]=1; draw(); }; });
    function pick(){ var P=b.items.filter(function(i){ return sel[i.code]; }); return P.length?P:b.items; }
    function txt(){ return '*Sunpack Industries — '+brand+'*\n_Packaging Freshness_\n\n'+pick().map(function(i,k){ return (k+1)+'. '+i.name+([i.spec,i.ml?i.ml+' ml':'',i.ppc?i.ppc+' pcs/ctn':''].filter(Boolean).length?' — '+[i.spec,i.ml?i.ml+' ml':'',i.ppc?i.ppc+' pcs/ctn':''].filter(Boolean).join(', '):'')+(rate&&i.rate?' — ₹'+i.rate+'/'+(i.unit||''):''); }).join('\n')+'\n\nPP Factory Sewah · PET Kurar'; }
    $('pfWa').onclick=function(){ window.open('https://wa.me/?text='+encodeURIComponent(txt()),'_blank'); };
    $('pfCopy').onclick=function(){ try{ navigator.clipboard.writeText(txt()).then(function(){ toast('Copied — paste in WhatsApp / mail'); }); }catch(e){ toast('Copy not allowed here'); } };
    $('pfPdf').onclick=function(){ var P=pick(); $('printArea').innerHTML='<div style="font-family:Inter,Arial;padding:10mm"><div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;border-bottom:3px solid '+c+';padding-bottom:8px"><img src="'+esc(LOGO)+'" style="height:50px"><div><div style="font:700 20px Georgia,serif;color:#13213f;letter-spacing:1px">SUNPACK INDUSTRIES</div><div style="color:#d0343c;font-style:italic">Packaging Freshness</div></div><div style="margin-left:auto;text-align:right"><div style="font-size:18px;font-weight:800;color:'+c+'">'+esc(brand)+'</div><div style="font-size:11px;color:#64748b">Product portfolio · '+new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-IN')+'</div></div></div>'+
      '<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:8px;margin-top:10px">'+P.map(function(i){ return '<div style="border:1px solid #e2e8f0;border-radius:10px;padding:8px;break-inside:avoid;display:flex;gap:8px"><div style="width:50px;height:50px;flex:none">'+(i.photo?'<img src="'+esc(i.photo)+'" style="max-width:50px;max-height:50px">':cupSvg(c,48))+'</div><div><b style="font-size:11.5px">'+esc(i.name)+'</b><div style="font-size:10px;color:#64748b">'+esc([i.spec,i.ml?i.ml+' ml':'',i.ppc?i.ppc+' pcs/ctn':''].filter(Boolean).join(' · '))+'</div>'+(rate&&i.rate?'<div style="font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700">₹'+esc(i.rate)+' / '+esc(i.unit||'')+'</div>':'')+'</div></div>'; }).join('')+'</div><div style="margin-top:10px;font-size:10px;color:#64748b;text-align:center">Sunpack Industries · PP Factory Sewah · PET Kurar</div></div>'; closeMod(); setTimeout(function(){ window.print(); },250); };
  }
  draw(); }
/* ---------- ✎ editors (Sirs): notices · certificates ---------- */
function editor(kind){ var x=S.x||{}, L=(kind==='notices'?(x.noticeSample?[]:x.notices):kind==='stars'?(x.starSample?[]:(x.stars||[]).map(function(a){ return {0:a[0],1:a[1]}; })):(x.certSample?[]:x.certs))||[]; L=L.slice();
  var F=kind==='stars'?[['0','Title (e.g. Best operator)',''],['1','Name · detail','']]:kind==='notices'?[['icon','Icon (emoji)','📌'],['text','Notice',''],['by','From / date','']]:[['name','Certificate',''],['line','One line (e.g. Quality management)',''],['link','PDF / photo link (Drive)',''],['expiry','Expiry date (yyyy-mm-dd)',''],['icon','Icon','✔'],['color','Colour (#hex)','#2563eb']];
  function row(o,k){ return '<div class="card" style="padding:10px;margin-bottom:8px" data-row="'+k+'">'+F.map(function(f){ return '<label style="font-size:11.5px;color:#64748b;display:block;margin-top:4px">'+f[1]+'<input class="fld" data-f="'+f[0]+'" value="'+esc(o[f[0]]==null?f[2]:o[f[0]])+'"></label>'; }).join('')+'<button class="edit" data-del="'+k+'" style="color:#dc2626;margin-top:6px">✕ Remove</button></div>'; }
  function draw(){ openMod('<h2 style="margin-bottom:10px">✎ '+(kind==='notices'?'Notice board':kind==='stars'?'Stars of the week':'Certificates')+'</h2><div id="edl">'+L.map(row).join('')+'</div><button class="btn l" id="edAdd">＋ Add</button><div class="pfa"><button class="btn l" data-x="1">Cancel</button><button class="btn n" id="edSave">Save</button></div>');
    $('edAdd').onclick=function(){ read(); L.push({}); draw(); };
    $('mbox').querySelectorAll('[data-del]').forEach(function(b){ b.onclick=function(){ read(); L.splice(+b.dataset.del,1); draw(); }; });
    $('edSave').onclick=async function(){ read(); this.disabled=true; try{ var r=await call('homeGSave',S.token,kind,L.filter(function(o){ return o.text||o.name||o[0]; }).map(function(o){ return kind==='stars'?[o[0]||'',o[1]||'']:o; })); S.x=r; closeMod(); paint(); toast('Saved — everyone sees it'); }catch(e){ toast((e&&e.message)||e); this.disabled=false; } }; }
  function read(){ $('mbox').querySelectorAll('[data-row]').forEach(function(r){ var o=L[+r.dataset.row]={}; r.querySelectorAll('[data-f]').forEach(function(i){ o[i.dataset.f]=i.value.trim(); }); }); }
  draw(); }

  apps:[{name:'Admin Console',desc:'Today · Factory · Business — overview, CARMA, decisions, bottlenecks, live factory',category:'Management',access:'Admins Only',url:'?app=admin'},{name:'PC – Process Coordinator',desc:'All FMS in one place · Enter for · MIS & Reports · Score',category:'Management',access:'Assigned users',url:'?app=coord'},{name:'Delegation',desc:'EA assigns tasks, follows up daily, weekly score',category:'Management',access:'Assigned users',url:'?app=dlg',sheetUrl:'#'},{name:'Order to Delivery & Collection',desc:'Order → Delivery → Payment collection (O2D / D2C)',category:'Sales',access:'Assigned users',url:'?app=so',sheetUrl:'#'},{name:'CRM – Customer Relations',desc:'SCOT calls · running orders · collection · complaints',category:'Sales',access:'Assigned users',url:'?app=crm',sheetUrl:'#'},{name:'NBD – New Business',desc:'Leads → enquiry → follow-up → first order',category:'Sales',access:'Assigned users',url:'?app=nbd',sheetUrl:'#'},{name:'Factory Desk',desc:'My work · requirement · dispatch · GRN · production',category:'Factory',access:'Assigned users',url:'?app=desk',sheetUrl:'#'},{name:'PMS – Production Management',desc:'Shift output, OEE, quality checks, packing jobs',category:'Production',access:'Admins only',url:'?app=pms',sheetUrl:'#'},{name:'IMS – Inventory Management',desc:'Stock in, stock out and live balance',category:'Inventory',access:'Staff and Admin',url:'?app=ims',sheetUrl:'#'},{name:'Raw Material Purchase',desc:'Raise requirement → order → follow-up → receive → QC → Tally',category:'Purchase',access:'Assigned users',url:'?app=po',sheetUrl:'#'},{name:'ACS – Accounts & Stock Check',desc:'My tasks · Physical check · Tally check · Invoices · Payments',category:'Accounts',access:'Assigned users',url:'?app=acs',sheetUrl:'#'},{name:'Attendance',desc:'Daily staff attendance',category:'HR',access:'Staff and Admin',soon:true},{name:'Gate Entry',desc:'Vehicles in / out',category:'Security',access:'Staff and Admin',soon:true}],

  homeMoreTasks:function(){ return [{app:'Decisions',short:'Decisions',url:'?app=admin',total:3,overdue:1,list:[]},{app:'Production plan 5 PM',short:'Plan (5 PM)',total:1,overdue:1,list:[]},{app:'Stock check gaps',short:'Stock check gaps',total:0,overdue:0,list:[]},{app:'PMS entries due',short:'PMS entries due',total:5,overdue:5,list:[]}]; },
  homeGData:function(){ return { brands:[{brand:'Sunpack',n:42,desc:'Disposable glass',rates:1,items:[{code:'SNP-GL150',name:'Glass 150 ml',spec:'Transparent',ml:150,ppc:2500,rate:0.42,unit:'pcs'},{code:'SNP-GL200',name:'Glass 200 ml',spec:'Transparent',ml:200,ppc:2000,rate:0.55,unit:'pcs'},{code:'SNP-GL250',name:'Glass 250 ml',spec:'Milky',ml:250,ppc:1500,rate:0.68,unit:'pcs'}]},{brand:'Symphony',n:60,desc:'Ice cream cups',items:[{code:'SHY-MNG14-40X100-PP',name:'MANGO 1.4 (40X100)',ppc:4000}]},{brand:'Olive Bio',n:12,desc:'Bio-degradable',items:[]},{brand:'Sunfresh',n:30,desc:'Containers',items:[]},{brand:'Wooden Spoon',n:11,desc:'Spoons',items:[]}],
   certs:[{name:'ISO 9001:2015',line:'Quality management',icon:'✔',color:'#2563eb',link:'#'},{name:'FSSAI',line:'Food-grade packaging',icon:'🍃',color:'#16a34a',link:'#',expiry:new Date(Date.now()+28*864e5).toISOString().slice(0,10)}], certSample:1,
   notices:[{icon:'🎉',text:'Diwali dispatch plan — last truck 31 Oct',by:'Bhupinder Sir'},{icon:'🛠',text:'TFM-3 PM on Sunday 8 AM',by:'Maintenance'}], noticeSample:1,
   stars:[['Best operator','Ramesh · TFM-2 · 96%'],['On time','Seema Mam · 100%']], starSample:1,
   today:[['3','orders to dispatch'],['5','shift entries due',1],['1','PO to approve'],['94%','tasks on time (7 d)'],['2','rates waiting'],['0','stock check gaps']] }; },
  logout:function(){ return true; } };
boot();

<script>/* Sunpack mobile app: when the portal is opened inside the installed app (?shell=1), moving between modules stays inside the app */
(function () { try { if (!(window.google && google.script && google.script.url)) return;
  google.script.url.getLocation(function (l) { if (!l || !l.parameter || !l.parameter.shell) return;
    var isApp = function (u) { u = String(u || ''); return /^\?/.test(u) || /script\.google\.com\/.*\/exec/.test(u); };
    var go = function (u) { window.top.postMessage({ sunpackGo: String(u) }, '*'); };
    var last = '#', rep = function () { var v = ''; try { v = localStorage.getItem('bp_token') || ''; } catch (e) {} if (v !== last) { last = v; window.top.postMessage({ sunpackToken: v }, 'https://bhupinder-gif.github.io'); } }; rep(); setInterval(rep, 1500);
    var wo = window.open; window.open = function (u) { if (u && isApp(u)) { go(u); return null; } return wo.apply(window, arguments); };
    document.addEventListener('click', function (e) { var a = e.target && e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('a[href]') : null; if (!a) return; var h = a.getAttribute('href') || ''; if (!isApp(h)) return; e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); go(h); }, true);
  }); } catch (e) {} })();
</script>
</body>
</html>
`;
